name: Structured Logs + Log Rotation
description: Wired the dead [logging] config: daily-rotating file handler, enforced log level, optional JSON format via python-json-logger, correlation_id filter, logger names normalized to archon_search.* across the package, plus a CI guard test.
effort: Mostly small one-line edits across many files, but wide touch surface. One new module, config fields with validation, one new dependency, docs update. No storage or migrations. Risks: uvicorn logging propagation, single-process-only rotation, upgrade turning file logging on by default.
